```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
library(CloneCensorWeight)
```

## Build post-CDM analysis data

`createSampleCloneCensorWeightData()` creates the same normalized tables that
the database extractor returns after reading OMOP cohort, exposure, outcome,
and baseline covariate tables. It is useful for tests and for checking an
analysis specification before connecting to a CDM. In a Eunomia workflow, the
same tables can be populated from the Eunomia cohort and feature tables.

```{r data}
ccwData <- createSampleCloneCensorWeightData(n = 200, seed = 2026)
c("cohorts", "outcomes", "covariates", "covariateRef", "analysisRef")
```

## Clone and censor

The first arm requires initiation during the 30-day grace period. The second
arm requires no initiation during that period. A deviating clone is censored at
the first protocol deviation.

```{r clone}
arms <- list(
  list(arm = "initiate", strategy = "initiate"),
  list(arm = "never", strategy = "never")
)
cloned <- createClonesAndCensor(ccwData, arms, gracePeriod = 30,
                                washoutPeriod = 0)
dplyr::collect(cloned$cohorts) |> head()
```

## Estimate censoring weights and outcome model

```{r model}
personTime <- discretizePersonTime(cloned, intervalLength = 30)
weighted <- createCensoringWeights(personTime, cloned)
computeWeightDistribution(weighted)
outcomeModel <- fitOutcomeModel(weighted, modelType = "cox")
outcomeModel$summary
```

The diagnostic plots use ordinary `ggplot2` objects and can be saved using
standard R graphics workflows.

```{r plots, eval=FALSE}
plotWeightDistribution(weighted)
plotKaplanMeier(weighted)
plotCovariateBalance(computeCovariateBalance(cloned, weighted))
```

## Standardized multi-analysis output

The multi-analysis runner creates one folder per analysis containing
`results.csv`, `weightDistribution.csv`, and an Andromeda cache.

```{r analyses}
analysis <- createCloneCensorWeightAnalysis(
  analysisId = "sample-30-day-cox", arms = arms, gracePeriod = 30,
  intervalLength = 30, modelType = "cox"
)
outputFolder <- tempfile("ccw-results-")
results <- runCloneCensorWeightAnalyses(ccwData, list(analysis), outputFolder)
results[[1]]$outcomeModel$summary
list.files(file.path(outputFolder, "sample-30-day-cox"))
```
